### Minor Changes

- [#12252](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/12252) [`bbf8a1a`](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/commit/bbf8a1af2c668223fd7ac570f0f5b3a4318e3095) Thanks [@thushanth-bengre-langchain](https://github.com/thushanth-bengre-langchain)! - Standardize finish reason on `message-finish` events and final `AIMessage`s. Provider integrations set `finish_reason` (raw provider value), `normalized_finish_reason` (`stop | length | tool_call | content_filter | refusal | context_exceeded | error | other`) and, for Anthropic, `finish_state` (`complete | suspended`) in `response_metadata`; events carry them as `finishReason`, `normalizedFinishReason` and `finishState`. Core no longer maps provider values: it passes these fields through and corrects two provider-agnostic cases (a refusal block becomes `refusal`, and `stop` with tool calls becomes `tool_call`). The `FinishReason` type changes from `stop | length | tool_use | content_filter` to the values above (`tool_use` is now `tool_call`). `MessageFinishEvent.reason` is deprecated but still emitted with its old values (`tool_call` maps to `tool_use`, `refusal` to `content_filter`, `context_exceeded` to `length`; left unset for `other` and `error`). `response_metadata.finish_reason` on streamed messages now holds the raw provider value instead of the normalized one.
releases.name: @langchain/core@1.5.0

### Minor Changes

- [#12184](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/12184) [`5a21380`](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/commit/5a213808e6038c822ce323426174229f7da3c924) Thanks [@thushanth-bengre-langchain](https://github.com/thushanth-bengre-langchain)! - feat(typesafe)!: implement `TypeSafeClassifier` as a decision model

  `TypeSafeClassifier` now extends `BaseDecisionModel` from `@langchain/core/decisions` and requires `@langchain/core` >= 1.4.0. This is a breaking change:

  - Questions are passed with each request instead of to the constructor: `new TypeSafeClassifier().invoke({ state, questions })` replaces `new TypeSafeClassifier({ questions }).invoke(state)`
  - Responses are core's `ClassifierResponse`. Token usage is `usage_metadata` (`input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `total_tokens`) instead of `usage` (`inputTokens`, `outputTokens`)
  - Question and answer types are re-exported from core, and every question requires `instructions`. `ClassificationResponse`, `QuestionContent` (now `Content`), `Usage`, `ValidatedQuestions`, `JsonValue`, and `TypeSafeClassifierCallOptions` are removed
  - Add `Box` questions, and send image content blocks in state or question content as TypeSafe image assets
  - An invalid question now throws a plain `Error` from `invoke` instead of a `TypeSafeError` from the constructor
  - `State` is core's type, which no longer lists `Date`; dates are still sent as ISO strings

releases.body:
### Minor Changes

- [#12178](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/12178) [`01e5f2d`](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/commit/01e5f2dbbf30823045fc82c69bef7b2c032315f4) Thanks [@thushanth-bengre-langchain](https://github.com/thushanth-bengre-langchain)! - feat(core): add decision models

  - Add `@langchain/core/decisions` with `BaseDecisionModel`, a `Runnable` that answers typed `Noul`, `Choice`, `Score`, and `Box` questions about text, messages, or JSON state
  - Add question and answer types, `parseQuestions`, and `parseClassifierResponse` for providers
  - Type `invoke` answers from the questions asked, including `Choice` labels, and reject provider responses that leave a question unanswered or answer it with the wrong type or label

  `modelRefusalMiddleware()` throws `ModelRefusalError` when the model refuses, instead of ending the run as if it succeeded. Middleware now passes `ModelRefusalError` through unwrapped instead of as a `MiddlewareError`.
